description_en: Modifies the name and description of a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
description_zh: 调用ModifyCenAttribute接口修改云企业网实例的名称和描述信息
name: ModifyCenAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN instance
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the CEN instance.

The name can be empty or 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
云企业网实例的名称。

名称可以为空或长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the CEN instance.

The description can be empty or 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
云企业网实例的描述信息。

描述可以为空或长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The level of CIDR block overlapping.

Valid values: REDUCED (default), which indicates that CIDR blocks can overlap but cannot be identical
parameters.help_zh:
设置网段重叠的级别。

取值：REDUCED（默认值），表示网段可以有重叠，但是不能完全相同
parameters.name: protection_level
